name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-session
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub mirrors the consumed contract surface of the dsh-private packages/core/session seam (Session/SessionEvent/SessionId types, the surface fold + projection helpers foldSurface/deriveEventMessage/isSurfaceEvent/findLastMessageTurnEnd, and the cordis session/event augmentation) and implements just enough behavior for real-composition tests. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
